---
name: Something doesn't work
about: A gesture misfires, setup fails, the camera isn't found…
---

**What I did** (which gesture, which hand)

**What happened instead**

**Setup**: Windows version, webcam (built-in / USB model), app version (from the zip name)

**Recording** (very helpful): run `GestureControl.exe --record`, reproduce the problem, Quit from the tray,
and attach the newest file from `%APPDATA%\GestureControl\recordings\sessions\`. It contains only
hand-point numbers, no pictures.

**Log**: `%APPDATA%\GestureControl\logs\gesture-control.log` (attach or paste the end of it)
